Granite Point Capital Management Lp increased its stake in Marinus Pharmaceuticals Inc (MRNS) by 379.78% based on its latest 2018Q2 regulatory filing with the SEC. Granite Point Capital Management Lp bought 2.09 million shares as the company’s stock declined 8.95% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund held 2.64 million shares of the health care company at the end of 2018Q2, valued at $18.65M, up from 549,900 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Granite Point Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Marinus Pharmaceuticals Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $221.27 million market cap company. The stock increased 1.30% or $0.07 during the last trading session, reaching $5.46. About 1.34 million shares traded or 103.33% up from the average. Marinus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ:MRNS) has risen 73.49% since November 4, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 57.87% the S&P500.
Granite Point Capital Management Lp, which manages about $1.12B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Ishares Russell 2000 Index (Etf) (Call) (IWM) by 400,000 shares to 600,000 shares, valued at $98.26M in 2018Q2, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Ishares Russell 2000 Index (Etf) (Put) (IWM) by 135,600 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 864,400 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (Call) (NASDAQ:AAPL).
